purpose: Plain-language requirements for a developer building the ecommerce operating system. IDs preserve reference continuity without publishing original messages.

requirements.summary: Provide methodology reference for the complete original private, cloud-hosted, multi-brand autonomous ecommerce engine. All required research, creative, stores, advertising and connected business operations are commissioned delivery, not a reduced core, pilot or future out-of-contract target. Historical agents, code and schemas illustrate methods, not supplied working software or guaranteed reusable components. Exclude private data.

The product is private and cloud-hosted, supports multiple brands/stores/accounts within one business, and includes a complete owner-controlled database. Preserve recent owner corrections and relevant historical methodology. Deliver commercially credible ads/pages and functioning business operations, not generic AI output or process terminology.

Begin with owner approval of creative direction and finished examples, then autonomous production, execution and improvement within approved permissions and budgets. Create the useful storefront and image/UGC/avatar/video capabilities represented by reference platforms inside the owned engine.

Own interface, source code, data, assets, history and workflows. Integrate supported engines where useful without turning the system into SaaS links. Prefer direct image and video APIs; use an aggregator such as Higgsfield only when its skill/full workflow improves actual rendered output, through an adapter within the owned creative engine. Do not require literally every vendor feature.

Include connected sourcing, quotes, diligence, negotiation, QC, purchasing, order routing, 3PL/fulfillment/tracking, returns, support, retention, bookkeeping/accounting and profitability functions in the commissioned delivery. This is not a requirement to own a physical warehouse, recreate payment rails or build an unrelated standalone ERP. These functions are not secondary or excluded.

Deliver private supplier discovery, outreach, quotes, negotiation, due diligence, samples, QC and purchasing workflows with source evidence, terms, landed costs and authority controls. They are included acceptance, not deferred to a future contract.

Connect dropshipping, bulk/private-label purchasing and inventory, selected warehouse/3PL order routing and fulfillment, tracking, exceptions and returns. Choose concrete providers and representative cases before hire. Platform, legal/KYC and owner approvals are dependencies with supported workflows, not capability exclusions.

Deliver autonomous execution within permissions and budgets. Solve poor creative quality through relevant competitor/customer evidence, product-specific copy and actual decoded visual/audio and functional page review against references. Reject generic AI slop, unfinished clips, fabricated reviews and unsupported claims without making routine work repetitive approval paperwork.
Run product discovery and profitable scaling together, allowing investment in learning while expanding successful products.

60 LIVE PRODUCT TESTS PER MONTH is mandatory operating capacity AND final acceptance. Each qualifying product test has research/economics/offer, finished reviewed ads, a functioning purchase destination, a live budgeted campaign with delivered traffic and actual spend, verified tracking, measured results and decisions. Rows, variants, duplicate relaunches, simulations and test-mode transactions do not count. Desired 2-3 scalable winners and majority break-even are aspirations, not guaranteed outcomes; that uncertainty does not waive the 60-test requirement.
An early tentative testing-budget suggestion was discussed and subsequently withdrawn as a design constraint.
The developer should recommend realistic resource requirements and economics rather than constrain the design to the earlier budget suggestion.

requirements.summary: The developer chooses the architecture. Repository content is methodology reference only, not a working codebase or a promise of reusable software.

Make the repository useful to a developer and coding assistant through clear workflow explanations, requirement summaries, memory-derived lessons, JSON/schema examples and traceable technical references. A separate browser chat application is not required.

Job-posting drafting history is supplementary. The current hiring copy and five screening questions express the approved scope, but preparing local publication text does not authorize external publication, hiring or spending.

Present owner intent as clearly attributed assistant-written summaries, not fabricated quotations. This developer methodology repository is public-safe; the commissioned application is private. The historical spelling amboris was mapped tentatively to Amboras as a storefront reference, with Arcads an ad/video/avatar reference. Current capability intent does not prove vendor identity, feature access or integration.

Current commercial position: $6,000-$8,000 negotiable fixed fee; $8,000 is a ceiling, not an automatic or committed fee. Target roughly one month with access ready. Agree final price, complete-delivery milestones, schedule, monthly measurement windows and operating budgets before hiring. The fee covers the full commissioned system, not only a core or pilot; milestones stage complete delivery and must accommodate monthly live-test acceptance.

Codex AND Claude power development AND the deployed engine through officially supported access. Verify runtime/automation/commercial terms, capacity, concurrency, allowances and recovery, never assume subscriptions include APIs or permit bypasses. Direct image AND video APIs are preferred; aggregator skills/full workflows must improve rendered output within the owned engine. The video-only API restriction is superseded. Disclose costs and obtain separate approval; no spend is authorized by this brief.

Clients are engineers using Codex, Claude and vibe coding. Unsupported padded manual-from-scratch estimates are unacceptable. Explain custom work, proven-component reuse, integrations, creative finishing, testing and deployment without invented coding hours or promised savings. Do not default to the ceiling. Honest technical pushback is welcome, not applicant disqualification. Ask for personal contributions, substantiable work and staged Looms.

Keep historical agent, creative and system documents as methodology reference. Their presence does not establish working software, reusable components or delivery-time savings. A source-family/revision inventory is not a count of failed full builds.

Make the methodology visible to developers: which data to scrape or collect, fields to preserve and evidence to cross-reference, product research, copywriting, video production and performance feedback. Use earlier workflows, agents and attributed course-derived summaries. Dropshipping, product research and high-converting store/ad experience are preferred.

Prefer a custom agent-led operating system over static automation chains. Remove stale automation exports from the current handoff unless they explain a useful methodology. Preserve research, before/after, AI UGC and node-based creative methods without prescribing n8n or other legacy orchestration. Deterministic execution primitives remain useful beneath agent decisions.

Keep up with the AI race, newer models, better agents and increasingly AGI-like capabilities through tested adaptability. Replace models/providers/runtimes/prompts/skills and whole workflows; combine or remove obsolete stages. Retain context, source/data/assets, history, external IDs and controls outside prompts. Compare actual quality/cost/speed/reliability, version and restore. Demonstrate replacement, simplification and restore without repeating external actions. No literal AGI, perpetual maintenance or permanent immunity to obsolescence is promised.

The full original private multi-brand business vision is the completed commissioned system, including sourcing, logistics and back-office functions. Earlier smaller-core, secondary-supplier and nonbinding-volume wording is superseded as of 2026-09-22. A demo, scaffold, disconnected automation, dashboard-only system or partial build is UNACCEPTABLE as final delivery. Initial applicant work samples are separate from final acceptance.
The developer may quote down toward $6,000 within a $6,000-$8,000 negotiable range. No price, milestone, deadline, award or new spending is committed by postings or applicant replies.

Include Meta Facebook Page creation/configuration, applicable Instagram linkage, business/ad-account connections and catalogs. Set up Pixel/CAPI and other agreed conversion tracking; verify event receipt, consent, product/variant/value/currency fields and browser/server purchase deduplication against Shopify orders. Keep test traffic distinct from live commercial results. Owner/legal/KYC/platform approvals remain dependencies, not exclusions.

Deliver complete Shopify store creation: domains, branding, native Liquid themes/sections/templates, responsive layouts/navigation, policies, checkout/payment and shipping. Catalog-scale products, variants, collections, copy/media/pricing, metafields/templates, bulk mutations/imports and store migration include draft review, stable IDs, item-level errors and duplicate-safe retries. Agree representative batch sizes and verify real purchase paths.

Provide visual product summaries for scraped products, landing pages and competitor ads, with images/previews, prices, source links/dates and concise assessments. The dashboard supports real research and execution rather than replacing them.

Include complete-delivery acceptance fixes, upgrade demonstration, deployment and handoff in the negotiated build. Paid extras require prior written scope and price approval. AI productivity does not excuse untested outputs. Separately price optional ongoing maintenance; no automatic budget increase or lifetime upgrades.

Amboras, Arcads, WinningHunter, Kalodata, Atria, Brandsearch and Higgsfield represent capabilities to CREATE inside the owned engine: research/ad/page intelligence, storefront construction, creative analytics and skills/workflows producing original finished outputs. Not a SaaS-link bundle, mandatory subscriptions or literal clone of all features. Vendor documentation does not prove current authenticated capability.

Retain and reuse first-party performance to improve briefs, creative, offers and pages, including failed tests. Research/scrape accessible top ads/pages, analyze hooks/pacing/narrative/CTA/angles, create ORIGINAL product-specific finished outputs, launch, measure and improve. Compare actual decoded and functional outputs to references and record a measured next iteration. Separate vendor estimates/training claims, application learning and actual weight training; preserve rights and accurate claims.

Implement and test conversion-led landing/product pages, bundles, upsells, cross-sells, post-purchase offers and SEO/AEO/GEO. Verify mobile/desktop purchase paths, structured data and discoverability implementation with supported Shopify features. No guaranteed conversion uplift, rankings or AI-answer placement.

Final acceptance requires an actual monthly run of 60 qualifying live product tests with a deduplicated ledger of product identity, research/economics, offer, finished ads, purchase destination, campaign, approved budget, delivered traffic, actual spend, verified tracking, outcomes and decisions. Agree monthly window/timezone, launch cadence, per-test observation/attribution periods, spend thresholds, stop/scale rules and reporting lag before hire. Blocked/unlaunched tests do not count; capacity forecasts and historical replay cannot substitute.

Ad/media/platform/model, hosting/storage, supplier/fulfillment and other operating spend is separate from the engineering fee and needs explicit approval. Disclose legal/KYC, permissions and owner actions with responsibility and schedule impact. Missing approval blocks acceptance rather than removing the capability; this repository authorizes no spend, publication, account action or hiring.

Finished UGC/avatar/image/video ads include editing, captions, audio, transitions, aspect ratios and exports. Require human review of actual decoded visual/audio outputs plus functional store/page/purchase review, reference comparisons and measured next iteration. A prompt, render-job receipt, isolated clip or model self-score is not completion.

Handoff includes owner-controlled source, database/migrations, adapters, tests, deployment/runbooks, business context/history/data/assets and a clean-environment restore. Enforce account separation, permissions, cost caps, validation and duplicate prevention outside prompts. Verify external effects by readback and preserve live-action history when restoring configurations.

scope_note: Current owner-approved scope reconciled 2026-09-22. Full original vision is commissioned delivery. Earlier smaller-core, supplier/back-office exclusions, nonbinding 60-test and video-only API wording is superseded; historical originals remain preserved evidence, not current authority. This public methodology repository supplies no implemented system.
